edits.before: Your Heartsteel bulk makes you a real frontline threat in five-versus-five but this lane never becomes a true duel. Ziggs' Short Fuse empowered autos and tower-demolishing passive mean he wins every side-lane siege while you chase him into his own minefield. Post-6 your best plan is to soak poke, match his split-push pressure by threatening with R transit time, and be the initiation body in grouped fights where your W shield and passive zombie matter. Trying to 1v1 him under his own conditions at any item stage is still not realistic — he simply stands behind E and Q-bounces you down.
